name: clock-73h-behind
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with the pump's clock set 73 hours back on its screen 180 minutes ago: it ends 73 hours behind the phone, so the app has to set it. Before it, a 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago and a 150% temp rate from 200 minutes ago that ends after the change; after it, a 1.0 U pump bolus 90 minutes ago, so the records either side of the change are stamped on different clocks.
